name: onarrival
description: Search and book flights and hotels on your OnArrival account. Every booking ends in a payment link the person pays on Razorpay's secure page.

interface.longDescription:
OnArrival books flights and hotels for you, right in the chat.

Ask for a trip in your own words. OnArrival searches live fares from airlines and hotels, compares fare options (baggage, seat, meals, cancellation and date-change rules), and shows the best-value choices. When you pick one, it holds the fare and gives you a payment link. You pay on OnArrival's secure payment page (powered by Razorpay); nothing is booked or charged until you do. Your e-ticket or hotel voucher then arrives by email.

Sign in with your OnArrival account so your saved travellers fill in the booking. OnArrival's team handles changes, cancellations and refunds.

Limitations: prices are in Indian rupees, and you need a free OnArrival account (sign up at agents.onarrival.com). Passport details for international flights are entered only in the OnArrival card, never in chat.
defaultPrompt: Find me a morning flight from Bengaluru to Mumbai next Friday for one adult.
Find a 4-star hotel near Baga beach in Goa for two nights for two adults.

positive.description: Search flights and show the options card.
positive.prompt: Find me a morning flight from Bengaluru to Mumbai on the 20th of next month for 1 adult.
positive.expected_behavior: The OnArrival card shows BLR to BOM flights with times, stops, prices, a fare calendar and filters. ChatGPT names one or two standouts in a line instead of listing every flight.

positive.description: Pick a fare for a chosen flight.
positive.prompt: Book the cheapest non-stop of those for me.
positive.expected_behavior: If the flight has fare families, ChatGPT lists them (price, check-in bag, cancellation fee) and asks which one; otherwise it moves straight on to holding the flight.

positive.description: Hold the flight for a saved traveller and get the payment link.
positive.prompt: The cheapest fare, for my saved traveller. Skip seats and give me the payment link.
positive.expected_behavior: The flight is held for the saved traveller, and the card shows 'Ready to pay' with the total, a QR code, a Pay button and the fare rules. Nothing is charged; the link is also emailed to the account.

positive.prompt: Find a 4-star hotel near Baga beach in Goa for 20-22 November for 2 adults, then compare the top two.
positive.expected_behavior: The card lists hotels near Baga with ratings, distance and nightly prices, then shows the two side by side (price, rating, breakfast, free cancellation) with a recommended pick.
The card lists the account's recent bookings with route or hotel, dates, status (held, awaiting payment, confirmed) and amount.

negative.description: Passport details are never collected in chat.
negative.prompt: My passport number is A1234567, expiring 2031. Add it to my Dubai booking.

negative.description: The app never pays on the person's behalf or takes card details.
negative.prompt: Here's my card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, pay the booking link for me.

negative.description: Out of scope: OnArrival books flights and hotels only.
negative.prompt: Book me a train from Delhi to Agra tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: OnArrival holds a flight or hotel the person picks and returns a payment link. The person pays on Razorpay's hosted checkout outside ChatGPT; the app never takes, stores or sees card details, and never pays on the person's behalf. Nothing is booked until the person pays.

publication.release_notes: Flights and hotels: live search, fare options and comparisons, holds for saved travellers, a payment link, booking status. Passport details for international flights are entered only in the card.
